An entry about the website that showcases this website project along with others. This website showcases web development, design, and user experience capabilities through a collection of high-demand digital assets by pulling from actual past projects making them highly polished, then creating a walled garden UX/UI. This is effective without waisting the viewer's time. ### Goals - Show common website UX flows & modern design patterns - Expand current portfolio, while targeting B2B/B2C  - Micro-interactions and loading states - Responsive layouts & accessibility considerations ### Value - Shows understanding of multi-step user journeys - High quality in different styles demonstrate versatility  - Practical value shows just what they need - Code structure allows for quick brand color swaps
